preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 3 and 2000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: n lines of input, each containing two integers x_i and y_i, representing the coordinates of the points
preconditions.description: The coordinates of the points are given in the input.

preconditions.expression: The string s has a length of n-2, consisting of 'L' and 'R' characters
preconditions.description: The string s represents the directions of the turns in the polygonal line.

preconditions.expression: No three points lie on the same line

postconditions.expression: Output is either a permutation of 1 to n or -1
postconditions.description: The output should be a valid permutation of the integers from 1 to n, or -1 if no such permutation exists.
The output permutation should result in a polygonal line that does not intersect itself.
The output permutation should result in a polygonal line that winds in the specified direction according to the string s.

invariants.expression: The input points are all distinct and no three lie on the same line
invariants.description: The input constraints are maintained throughout the computation.
